name: SmartInvoice AI
summary: Making the business of getting paid simpler.
description: An invoicing and expense management project connecting recurring billing, receipt processing, and financial reporting.
technologies: .NET 8 / .NET 9, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server
challenge: Billing schedules, contracts, and receipts each have their own rules. The system needs to keep those workflows understandable and maintainable.
approach: An API-first backend with explicit command and query handlers, separate billing modules, and background processing for recurring invoices.
